email.reset.subject: Reset your Pulse password
email.reset.body: Use this link to choose a new password. It expires in 1 hour: {url}

email.siteLive.body: We received the first visit from {domain}. Your site is live — issues will show up in Today: {url}
email.install.subject: Please add DXM Pulse to {domain}
email.magic2fa.subject: Sign in to Pulse with your password
email.magic2fa.body:
Someone asked for a sign-in link for this email. Your account uses two-step verification, so email links are turned off for it. Sign in with your password and authenticator code instead: {url}

If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

email.digest.topFix: The fix that needs you most:

email.digest.siteNoScore: {site}: not enough visits for a health score yet ({visits, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}})
email.digest.unsubscribe: You get this email every Monday. To stop it, open: {url}
push.test.title: Pulse — test
push.test.body: Notifications for {org} will arrive on this device.
email.billing.invoice.subject: Pulse invoice #{number} for {org}: {amount}
email.billing.invoice.body:
Your {plan} plan for {org} renews on {due}.

Invoice #{number}: {amount}, covering the period up to {until}.

Pay with telebirr, a card or your bank app (through Chapa) here: {url}

If it isn't paid by {due}, the plan keeps working for 7 more days. After that Pulse stops storing new sessions until the invoice is paid. Your existing data stays readable.
email.billing.pastDue.subject: Pulse invoice #{number} for {org} is overdue
email.billing.restricted.subject: Pulse has stopped storing new sessions for {org}
email.billing.restricted.body:
The invoice for {org} wasn't paid within the grace period, so Pulse has stopped storing new sessions. Nothing has been deleted: you can still read your fixes, replays and reports.

Pay the open invoice to switch everything back on: {url}
email.billing.receipt.subject: Receipt: Pulse invoice #{number} paid ({amount})
email.billing.receipt.body:
We received {amount} for invoice #{number} ({plan} plan, {org}). Thank you.

Your plan is paid up to {until}. Invoices and receipts are in Settings → Billing: {url}
